title: Husqvarna T35 Professional Tap Advance Universal Trimmer Head and 0.095-Inch Titanium Force Trimmer Line Bundle
features: Includes T35 universal trimmer head compatible with Husqvarna, Echo, Stihl and RedMax straight shaft trimmers along with 0.095-inch, 140-foot Titanium Force trimmer line.
T35 head holds 0.065-inch to 0.105-inch line with a capacity of 28 feet of 0.095-inch line and comes pre-wound.
Titanium Force line made of commercial-grade polymer for durability, performance and efficiency with patented quiet design (reduces noise by 50%).
T35 head fits Husqvarna 123L to 326RJx models, Echo SRM-210 to SRM-3100S models, RedMax BC2601 to EXZ2500BC models and more.
T35 head includes adapter package for attaching to most other brands.
